responsibility: Implements GCC’s in-memory CTF container subsystem, the shared translation-unit data store used by both CTF and BTF generation. This file manages container lifecycle, type and variable hash tables keyed by DWARF DIEs, string tables, ordered member and function-argument lists, type/variable lookup and de-duplication, source-location extraction hooks, and the creation/insertion routines for CTF records such as integers, arrays, structs/unions, functions, slices, modifiers, and variables, producing the normalized container that later output files serialize.
same_name_distinction: Implements the CTF container API and mutable per-translation-unit state declared in ctfc.h: allocation, string tables, type/variable hash tables, deduplication, source-location queries, and record-construction routines. Unlike ctfc.h, this file is the executable container-management implementation rather than the shared data-model/interface definition.
